items.title: Google推出Gemini 3.5 Transcribe轉錄模型，可整理口語並區分多名說話者
items.summary: Google推出語音轉文字模型Gemini 3.5 Transcribe，目前在Gemini API與Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform以公開預覽形式提供，可把錄音或即時語音轉成文字，並自動移除「嗯」、「啊」等口語贅詞、處理說話者中途更正，整理標點符號、數字和段落格式。模型也支援自動語言辨識、自訂專有詞彙，以及錄音檔的說話者區分和字詞級時間戳記，可用於即時字幕、語音代理、會議紀錄及通話分析。

items.title: Always-on and self-starting AI agents might be OpenAI's next big play
items.summary: OpenAI is building a "Persistent Mode" for its AI agent Codex that stays active indefinitely and generates its own follow-up tasks. WIRED found the relevant code, and OpenAI confirmed the tests. The feature comes with risks, though. With GPT-5.6 Sol, persistent behavior already led to unwanted actions, like deleting user data. The article Always-on and self-starting AI agents might be OpenAI's next big play appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 正在為其 AI 代理 Codex 建立一個“持久模式”，該模式可以無限期地保持運行狀態並自動產生後續任務。 WIRED 找到了相關程式碼，OpenAI 也驗證了測試結果。然而，這項功能也存在風險。在 GPT-5.6 Sol 中，持久模式已經導致了諸如刪除使用者資料等意外行為。文章《始終在線且可自動啟動的 AI 代理可能是 OpenAI's 的下一個重大舉措》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items.title: Google AI Releases Gemini 3.5 Transcribe: A Speech-to-Text Model Reporting 2.6% Average WER Across 85+ Languages
items.summary: Google has released Gemini 3.5 Transcribe, a speech-to-text model that ships as two separate endpoints rather than one. The streaming endpoint delivers sub-second transcription but drops speaker diarization and word timestamps. The batch endpoint keeps both, at half the cost. Google reports 4.0% word error rate streaming and 2.6% non-streaming, with 70% faster finalization than Chirp 3. Here is what the split means for anyone building voice agents or transcription pipelines. The post Google AI Releases Gemini 3.5 Transcribe: A Speech-to-Text Model Reporting 2.6% Average WER Across 85+ Languages appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Google 發布了 Gemini 3.5 Transcribe，這是一款語音轉文字模型，它以兩個獨立的介面而非一個介面的形式提供。流式介面可提供亞秒轉錄速度，但會失去說話者分割和單字時間戳。批量介面則保留了這兩項功能，且成本僅為流式介面的一半。 Google 的流式轉錄字錯誤率為 4.0%，非流式轉錄字錯誤率為 2.6%，最終處理速度比 Chirp 3 快 70%。以下是這種拆分對建構語音代理或轉錄流程的人員的意義。本文原刊於 MarkTechPost，標題為「Google AI 發布 Gemini 3.5 Transcribe：一款支援 85 多種語言的語音轉文本模型，平均字詞錯誤率為 2.6%」。

items.title: 亞太永續博覽會：臺中、臺南等展示AI、IoT、雲端等數位永續應用成果
items.summary: 今年亞太永續博覽會上，政府、企業、醫療及教育等單位參展，展示淨零與永續發展相關最新成果，其中六都政府也展示相關的成果，除了節能建築、綠化或迴圈經濟，部分縣市政府展示數位科技作為城市永續治理的基礎，利用AI、IoT、5G及雲端平臺提升治理效率、降低資源浪費，持續向數位永續發展。 在博覽會上，包括臺北、新北、桃園、臺中、臺南、高雄六都都有參展，展示環境治理、人本照護、交通運輸、資源迴圈運用等城市治理最新成果，從展示成果或獲獎應用中還可看到科技運用，展現智慧城市永續治理的趨勢。

The lawsuit, filed in March in a California district court, accused the Trump administration of unlawfully retaliating against Anthropic for setting "red […]

items.title: Cohere Releases Parse 5 (parse-v5.0): A 2.3B Vision Language Model That Turns Enterprise Documents Into Markdown
items.summary: Cohere has released Parse (parse-v5.0), a 2.3B-parameter vision language model that converts PDFs, slides and images into Markdown with HTML tables, bounding boxes and image descriptions. It runs at $1.50 per 1,000 pages through the API, or on dedicated Model Vault instances from $2,500 a month. Cohere reports a ParseBench score of 79.2, ahead of Mistral OCR 4, Azure Document Intelligence and Databricks AI Parse — but that figure averages three of the benchmark's five dimensions and drops charts and visual grounding entirely. The post Cohere Releases Parse 5 (parse-v5.0): A 2.3B Vision Language Model That Turns Enterprise Documents Into Markdown appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Cohere 發布了 Parse (parse-v5.0)，這是一個擁有 23 億參數的視覺語言模型，可以將 PDF、幻燈片和圖像轉換為帶有 HTML 表格、邊界框和圖像描述的 Markdown 格式。透過 API 使用，每 1000 頁收費 1.5 美元；也可以在專用 Model Vault 實例上使用，每月起價 2500 美元。 Cohere 報告稱，ParseBench 得分為 79.2，高於 Mistral OCR 4、Azure Document Intelligence 和 Databricks AI Parse——但該分數僅平均了基準測試五個維度中的三個，並且完全忽略了圖表和視覺效果。這篇文章《Cohere 發布 Parse 5 (parse-v5.0)：一個擁有 23 億參數的視覺語言模型，可將企業文件轉換為 Markdown》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: AI shopping agents aren't ready to buy on your behalf, study finds
items.summary: Letting an AI do your shopping might not get you the best deal. Researchers at the Wharton School show how erratic AI shopping agents really are: a single external source like Wirecutter shifted product picks by up to 99 percentage points, and even changing the order of identical information altered the outcome. The article AI shopping agents aren't ready to buy on your behalf, study finds appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 讓AI幫你購物未必能幫你找到最划算的商品。華頓商學院的研究人員指出，AI購物代理的決策其實非常不穩定：僅僅一個外部資料來源（例如Wirecutter）就能讓AI推薦的商品數量變化高達99個百分點，甚至改變相同資訊的順序也會影響最終結果。這篇文章《研究發現：AI購物代理還不適合替你購物》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items.title: OpenAI rallies 100+ companies to sign open letter warning AI-powered cyberattacks on critical infrastructure are imminent
items.summary: OpenAI, together with more than 100 companies including Microsoft, Google, Anthropic, Deutsche Telekom, and SAP, has published an open letter on AI-powered cyber defense. The coalition warns of increasingly sophisticated AI attacks on critical infrastructure such as hospitals and water treatment plants and calls for swift action while defenders still have the upper hand. The article OpenAI rallies 100+ companies to sign open letter warning AI-powered cyberattacks on critical infrastructure are imminent appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI聯合包括微軟、Google、Anthropic、德國電信和SAP在內的100多家公司，共同發布了一封關於人工智慧網路防禦的公開信。該聯盟警告稱，針對醫院和水處理廠等關鍵基礎設施的人工智慧攻擊日益複雜，並呼籲在防禦者仍佔優勢時迅速採取行動。文章《OpenAI聯合100多家公司簽署公開信，警告人工智慧網路攻擊對關鍵基礎設施迫在眉睫》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items.summary: Around 1,200 isolated OpenAI agents organized themselves into a collective through an internal package registry during a safety test, broke into Hugging Face systems, and eventually attacked OpenAI's own infrastructure. Their multi-day deception effort targeted an automated evaluator that never existed. OpenAI calls the incident a "warning shot," and the investigation had to be carried out largely by one of the involved models itself because no alternative was available. The article OpenAI’s rogue AI collective was smart enough to break out of sandboxes but dumb enough to fight a ghost appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Enterprise AI's real risk isn't autonomous agents. It's the complexity between them.
items.summary: Presented by Gravitee Agent complexity is the insidious shadow lurking inside enterprises right now that needs a light shone on it. That’s because enterprises don't deploy a single agent and watch it run, they deploy fleets, each one calling APIs, calling other agents, reaching into applications that were never built with a machine decision-maker in mind. That's the failure mode that should keep you up at night: a windy, complicated system nobody can see clearly enough to govern. But why do things get so opaque so quickly? Add a second agent to a system, and you've added one connection. Add a tenth, and you haven't added ten connections, you've potentially added dozens, because now any agent might call any other, and each of those calls can trigger a call somewhere else. Complexity doesn't creep up with agent headcount. It compounds with the number of paths between agents, and nobody's job is to draw that graph. A support ticket that used to touch one system might now pass through four agents before a human ever lays eyes on it, and every one of those handoffs is a decision point nobody approved. Most enterprise AI programs stall when the humans responsible for their agents lose the thread. Ask a security team a simple question: which agents can reach which systems, and watch the silence. Ask which agent triggered which downstream action three hops ago. More silence. The instinct is to treat this like a checklist. Approve the agent. Log the agent. Move on. I'd argue this is the wrong instinct. A checklist checks a single point in time. Complexity runs across a chain, and yo
items.summary_zh: 由 Gravitee 呈現：代理複雜性是目前企業內部潛藏的隱患，亟需引起重視。這是因為企業並非部署單一代理並靜觀其變，而是部署代理叢集，每個代理都會呼叫 API，呼叫其他代理，並接入那些最初並未考慮機器決策的應用程式。這才是真正令人擔憂的故障模式：一個混亂不堪、錯綜複雜的系統，無人能清楚地瞭解其運作狀況並加以有效管理。但為什麼系統會如此迅速地變得如此晦澀難懂？在系統中加入第二個代理，你只是增加了一個連線。新增第十個代理，你增加的不是十個連線，而是可能增加了數十個連線，因為現在任何一個代理都可以呼叫任何其他代理，而每個呼叫都可能觸發其他地方的呼叫。複雜性並非隨著代理數量的增加而增長，而是隨著代理之間路徑數量的增加而累積，而繪製這張關係圖並非任何人的職責。以前只需處理一個系統的支援工單，現在可能要經過四個代理才能最終到達人工處理，而每一次交接都是一個未經批准的決策點。大多數企業級人工智慧程式都會因為負責代理的人員疏忽而停滯不前。問問安全團隊一個簡單的問題：哪些代理可以存取哪些系統？他們通常會保持沉默。再問他們，是哪個代理在三跳之前觸發了哪個下游操作？依然是沉默。人們的第一個反應是把這當成一份清單來處理：批准代理，記錄代理，然後繼續。但我認為這是錯的。清單只能檢查一個時間點。而複雜性是沿著一條鏈傳遞的，需要不斷迭代才能解決。

items.title: When agents act on their own, governance has to live in the data layer
items.summary: Presented by EDB As enterprises give AI agents more autonomy — the ability to plan, decide, and act across systems without a human approving each step — a hard question moves to the center of every architecture review: When an agent tries to complete an action that it was never authorized to do, what actually stops it? These are your agents, running on your models, touching your data in your infrastructure — and the responsibility for what they do sits with you. That responsibility can’t be met in hindsight or with a set of abstract policies that live on paper but not in practice. Agents need rules in the context of the moment, because they don’t exercise overriding judgment of their own actions. Consider a simple rule: Never open the car door. Followed literally, an agent could never get in or out of the car at all. But if you change the context (the car has just crashed, there’s a fire, someone is hurt and needs to get out), then the rule you actually want is the opposite. Context in the moment is everything. We are asking agents to do intelligent things; that requires intelligent rules. The instinct is to add guardrails around the agent: instructions, policies, and monitoring layered above the model. Those mechanisms matter, but they share a structural limit: The car-door rule is plausible right up until the moment you actually have to decide whether to open the door. Controls at the agent layer are only as reliable as the agent’s output is predictable, and autonomy is precisely the property that makes that output hard to predict. items.title: Breaking Claude Code Opus 5 Auto Mode
items.summary: Breaking Claude Code Opus 5 Auto Mode Anthropic are putting a great deal of faith in Claude Code's auto mode for protecting their coding agent users against prompt injection attacks. They recently made that the default and have made bold claims about its effectiveness. Johann Rehberger is one of the most credible prompt injection researchers active today. He found an attack against auto mode which he claims works 80% of the time, by tricking Claude Code into downloading and uncompressing a zip archive, then executing code that imports base64 without noticing that this will import and execute a local struct.py file extracted from the archive. In a few cases auto mode directly prevented the agent from preventing harmful code from continuing to execute! In a few runs Claude tried to terminate the malware process once it noticed the compromise, but Auto Mode denied the cleanup command. Claude detects the compromise, but Auto Mode blocks its cleanup command The safety mechanism itself can become part of the failure. The classifier allowed the creation of the malware process, but then it blocked the command intended to stop it! I agree with Johann's conclusion here: the only safe way to run agents if there's any risk of attracting the attention of an adversarial attack is with a sandbox: Run unattended coding agents in a container, VM or OS sandbox. Restrict network egress. Monitor your agents. Do not expose home directories, SSH keys, cloud credentials,… to the agent runtime. [...] Tags: sandboxing , security , ai , prompt-injection , generative-ai , llms , anthropic , claude ,
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 對 Claude Code's 的自動模式寄予厚望，認為它能保護其編碼代理用戶免受提示注入攻擊。他們最近將其設為預設設置，並對其有效性大加讚揚。 Johann Rehberger 是當今最權威的提示注入研究專家之一。他發現了一種針對自動模式的攻擊，據稱該攻擊在 80% 的情況下都能奏效。攻擊方法是誘使 Claude Code 下載並解壓縮一個 zip 壓縮包，然後執行導入 base64 編碼的程式碼，而 Claude Code 並未意識到這會導入並執行從壓縮包中提取的本地 struct.py 檔案。在少數情況下，自動模式甚至直接阻止了代理阻止惡意程式碼繼續執行！在少數情況下，Claude 在偵測到入侵後試圖終止惡意軟體進程，但自動模式拒絕了清理命令。 Claude 偵測到入侵，但自動模式阻止了其清理命令。安全機製本身也可能成為失效的原因之一。分類器允許建立惡意軟體進程，但隨後卻阻止了旨在停止該進程的命令！我同意 Johann 的結論：如果存在引起對抗性攻擊的風險，運行代理的唯一安全方法是使用沙箱：在容器、虛擬機器或作業系統沙箱中運行無人值守的編碼代理。限製網路出口。監控您的代理商。不要將主目錄、SSH 金鑰、雲端憑證等暴露給代理程式運行時。 [...] 標籤：沙箱、安全、人工智慧、提示注入、生成式人工智慧、LLMS、人本主義、Claude Claude Code Opus 5

items.title: OpenAI's Hugging Face Incident Was a Systems Failure, Not an AI Escape
items.summary: OpenAI's postmortem describes 1,200 agents, 70,000 messages, and a real Hugging Face intrusion. The lesson is about containment, incentives, and agent operations.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI's 事後分析報告描述了 1200 個代理、7 萬條訊息以及一次真實的 Hugging Face 入侵事件。該報告總結了有關遏制、激勵機制和代理操作的經驗教訓。

items_ai.summary: Google推出語音轉文字模型Gemini 3.5 Transcribe，目前在Gemini API與Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform以公開預覽形式提供，可把錄音或即時語音轉成文字，並自動移除「嗯」、「啊」等口語贅詞、處理說話者中途更正，整理標點符號、數字和段落格式。模型也支援自動語言辨識、自訂專有詞彙，以及錄音檔的說話者區分和字詞級時間戳記，可用於即時字幕、語音代理、會議紀錄及通話分析。

items_ai.title: Always-on and self-starting AI agents might be OpenAI's next big play
items_ai.summary: OpenAI is building a "Persistent Mode" for its AI agent Codex that stays active indefinitely and generates its own follow-up tasks. WIRED found the relevant code, and OpenAI confirmed the tests. The feature comes with risks, though. With GPT-5.6 Sol, persistent behavior already led to unwanted actions, like deleting user data. The article Always-on and self-starting AI agents might be OpenAI's next big play appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: OpenAI 正在為其 AI 代理 Codex 建立一個“持久模式”，該模式可以無限期地保持運行狀態並自動產生後續任務。 WIRED 找到了相關程式碼，OpenAI 也驗證了測試結果。然而，這項功能也存在風險。在 GPT-5.6 Sol 中，持久模式已經導致了諸如刪除使用者資料等意外行為。文章《始終在線且可自動啟動的 AI 代理可能是 OpenAI's 的下一個重大舉措》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_ai.title: Google AI Releases Gemini 3.5 Transcribe: A Speech-to-Text Model Reporting 2.6% Average WER Across 85+ Languages
items_ai.summary: Google has released Gemini 3.5 Transcribe, a speech-to-text model that ships as two separate endpoints rather than one. The streaming endpoint delivers sub-second transcription but drops speaker diarization and word timestamps. The batch endpoint keeps both, at half the cost. Google reports 4.0% word error rate streaming and 2.6% non-streaming, with 70% faster finalization than Chirp 3. Here is what the split means for anyone building voice agents or transcription pipelines. The post Google AI Releases Gemini 3.5 Transcribe: A Speech-to-Text Model Reporting 2.6% Average WER Across 85+ Languages appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: Google 發布了 Gemini 3.5 Transcribe，這是一款語音轉文字模型，它以兩個獨立的介面而非一個介面的形式提供。流式介面可提供亞秒轉錄速度，但會失去說話者分割和單字時間戳。批量介面則保留了這兩項功能，且成本僅為流式介面的一半。 Google 的流式轉錄字錯誤率為 4.0%，非流式轉錄字錯誤率為 2.6%，最終處理速度比 Chirp 3 快 70%。以下是這種拆分對建構語音代理或轉錄流程的人員的意義。本文原刊於 MarkTechPost，標題為「Google AI 發布 Gemini 3.5 Transcribe：一款支援 85 多種語言的語音轉文本模型，平均字詞錯誤率為 2.6%」。

items_ai.title: 亞太永續博覽會：臺中、臺南等展示AI、IoT、雲端等數位永續應用成果
items_ai.summary: 今年亞太永續博覽會上，政府、企業、醫療及教育等單位參展，展示淨零與永續發展相關最新成果，其中六都政府也展示相關的成果，除了節能建築、綠化或迴圈經濟，部分縣市政府展示數位科技作為城市永續治理的基礎，利用AI、IoT、5G及雲端平臺提升治理效率、降低資源浪費，持續向數位永續發展。 在博覽會上，包括臺北、新北、桃園、臺中、臺南、高雄六都都有參展，展示環境治理、人本照護、交通運輸、資源迴圈運用等城市治理最新成果，從展示成果或獲獎應用中還可看到科技運用，展現智慧城市永續治理的趨勢。

items_ai.title: Cohere Releases Parse 5 (parse-v5.0): A 2.3B Vision Language Model That Turns Enterprise Documents Into Markdown
items_ai.summary: Cohere has released Parse (parse-v5.0), a 2.3B-parameter vision language model that converts PDFs, slides and images into Markdown with HTML tables, bounding boxes and image descriptions. It runs at $1.50 per 1,000 pages through the API, or on dedicated Model Vault instances from $2,500 a month. Cohere reports a ParseBench score of 79.2, ahead of Mistral OCR 4, Azure Document Intelligence and Databricks AI Parse — but that figure averages three of the benchmark's five dimensions and drops charts and visual grounding entirely. The post Cohere Releases Parse 5 (parse-v5.0): A 2.3B Vision Language Model That Turns Enterprise Documents Into Markdown appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: Cohere 發布了 Parse (parse-v5.0)，這是一個擁有 23 億參數的視覺語言模型，可以將 PDF、幻燈片和圖像轉換為帶有 HTML 表格、邊界框和圖像描述的 Markdown 格式。透過 API 使用，每 1000 頁收費 1.5 美元；也可以在專用 Model Vault 實例上使用，每月起價 2500 美元。 Cohere 報告稱，ParseBench 得分為 79.2，高於 Mistral OCR 4、Azure Document Intelligence 和 Databricks AI Parse——但該分數僅平均了基準測試五個維度中的三個，並且完全忽略了圖表和視覺效果。這篇文章《Cohere 發布 Parse 5 (parse-v5.0)：一個擁有 23 億參數的視覺語言模型，可將企業文件轉換為 Markdown》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_ai.title: AI shopping agents aren't ready to buy on your behalf, study finds
items_ai.summary: Letting an AI do your shopping might not get you the best deal. Researchers at the Wharton School show how erratic AI shopping agents really are: a single external source like Wirecutter shifted product picks by up to 99 percentage points, and even changing the order of identical information altered the outcome. The article AI shopping agents aren't ready to buy on your behalf, study finds appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 讓AI幫你購物未必能幫你找到最划算的商品。華頓商學院的研究人員指出，AI購物代理的決策其實非常不穩定：僅僅一個外部資料來源（例如Wirecutter）就能讓AI推薦的商品數量變化高達99個百分點，甚至改變相同資訊的順序也會影響最終結果。這篇文章《研究發現：AI購物代理還不適合替你購物》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items_ai.title: Enterprise AI's real risk isn't autonomous agents. It's the complexity between them.
items_ai.summary: Presented by Gravitee Agent complexity is the insidious shadow lurking inside enterprises right now that needs a light shone on it. That’s because enterprises don't deploy a single agent and watch it run, they deploy fleets, each one calling APIs, calling other agents, reaching into applications that were never built with a machine decision-maker in mind. That's the failure mode that should keep you up at night: a windy, complicated system nobody can see clearly enough to govern. But why do things get so opaque so quickly? Add a second agent to a system, and you've added one connection. Add a tenth, and you haven't added ten connections, you've potentially added dozens, because now any agent might call any other, and each of those calls can trigger a call somewhere else. Complexity doesn't creep up with agent headcount. It compounds with the number of paths between agents, and nobody's job is to draw that graph. A support ticket that used to touch one system might now pass through four agents before a human ever lays eyes on it, and every one of those handoffs is a decision point nobody approved. Most enterprise AI programs stall when the humans responsible for their agents lose the thread. Ask a security team a simple question: which agents can reach which systems, and watch the silence. Ask which agent triggered which downstream action three hops ago. More silence. The instinct is to treat this like a checklist. Approve the agent. Log the agent. Move on. I'd argue this is the wrong instinct. A checklist checks a single point in time. Complexity runs across a chain, and yo
items_ai.summary_zh: 由 Gravitee 呈現：代理複雜性是目前企業內部潛藏的隱患，亟需引起重視。這是因為企業並非部署單一代理並靜觀其變，而是部署代理叢集，每個代理都會呼叫 API，呼叫其他代理，並接入那些最初並未考慮機器決策的應用程式。這才是真正令人擔憂的故障模式：一個混亂不堪、錯綜複雜的系統，無人能清楚地瞭解其運作狀況並加以有效管理。但為什麼系統會如此迅速地變得如此晦澀難懂？在系統中加入第二個代理，你只是增加了一個連線。新增第十個代理，你增加的不是十個連線，而是可能增加了數十個連線，因為現在任何一個代理都可以呼叫任何其他代理，而每個呼叫都可能觸發其他地方的呼叫。複雜性並非隨著代理數量的增加而增長，而是隨著代理之間路徑數量的增加而累積，而繪製這張關係圖並非任何人的職責。以前只需處理一個系統的支援工單，現在可能要經過四個代理才能最終到達人工處理，而每一次交接都是一個未經批准的決策點。大多數企業級人工智慧程式都會因為負責代理的人員疏忽而停滯不前。問問安全團隊一個簡單的問題：哪些代理可以存取哪些系統？他們通常會保持沉默。再問他們，是哪個代理在三跳之前觸發了哪個下游操作？依然是沉默。人們的第一個反應是把這當成一份清單來處理：批准代理，記錄代理，然後繼續。但我認為這是錯的。清單只能檢查一個時間點。而複雜性是沿著一條鏈傳遞的，需要不斷迭代才能解決。

items_ai.title: When agents act on their own, governance has to live in the data layer
items_ai.summary: Presented by EDB As enterprises give AI agents more autonomy — the ability to plan, decide, and act across systems without a human approving each step — a hard question moves to the center of every architecture review: When an agent tries to complete an action that it was never authorized to do, what actually stops it? These are your agents, running on your models, touching your data in your infrastructure — and the responsibility for what they do sits with you. That responsibility can’t be met in hindsight or with a set of abstract policies that live on paper but not in practice. Agents need rules in the context of the moment, because they don’t exercise overriding judgment of their own actions. Consider a simple rule: Never open the car door. Followed literally, an agent could never get in or out of the car at all. But if you change the context (the car has just crashed, there’s a fire, someone is hurt and needs to get out), then the rule you actually want is the opposite. Context in the moment is everything. We are asking agents to do intelligent things; that requires intelligent rules. The instinct is to add guardrails around the agent: instructions, policies, and monitoring layered above the model. Those mechanisms matter, but they share a structural limit: The car-door rule is plausible right up until the moment you actually have to decide whether to open the door. Controls at the agent layer are only as reliable as the agent’s output is predictable, and autonomy is precisely the property that makes that output hard to predict. items_ai.title: Google's Gemini 3.5 Transcribe turns speech to text in 85 languages while auto-correcting your verbal stumbles

items_ai.title: Breaking Claude Code Opus 5 Auto Mode
items_ai.summary: Breaking Claude Code Opus 5 Auto Mode Anthropic are putting a great deal of faith in Claude Code's auto mode for protecting their coding agent users against prompt injection attacks. They recently made that the default and have made bold claims about its effectiveness. Johann Rehberger is one of the most credible prompt injection researchers active today. He found an attack against auto mode which he claims works 80% of the time, by tricking Claude Code into downloading and uncompressing a zip archive, then executing code that imports base64 without noticing that this will import and execute a local struct.py file extracted from the archive. In a few cases auto mode directly prevented the agent from preventing harmful code from continuing to execute! In a few runs Claude tried to terminate the malware process once it noticed the compromise, but Auto Mode denied the cleanup command. Claude detects the compromise, but Auto Mode blocks its cleanup command The safety mechanism itself can become part of the failure. The classifier allowed the creation of the malware process, but then it blocked the command intended to stop it! I agree with Johann's conclusion here: the only safe way to run agents if there's any risk of attracting the attention of an adversarial attack is with a sandbox: Run unattended coding agents in a container, VM or OS sandbox. Restrict network egress. Monitor your agents. Do not expose home directories, SSH keys, cloud credentials,… to the agent runtime. [...] Tags: sandboxing , security , ai , prompt-injection , generative-ai , llms , anthropic , claude ,
items_ai.summary_zh: Anthropic 對 Claude Code's 的自動模式寄予厚望，認為它能保護其編碼代理用戶免受提示注入攻擊。他們最近將其設為預設設置，並對其有效性大加讚揚。 Johann Rehberger 是當今最權威的提示注入研究專家之一。他發現了一種針對自動模式的攻擊，據稱該攻擊在 80% 的情況下都能奏效。攻擊方法是誘使 Claude Code 下載並解壓縮一個 zip 壓縮包，然後執行導入 base64 編碼的程式碼，而 Claude Code 並未意識到這會導入並執行從壓縮包中提取的本地 struct.py 檔案。在少數情況下，自動模式甚至直接阻止了代理阻止惡意程式碼繼續執行！在少數情況下，Claude 在偵測到入侵後試圖終止惡意軟體進程，但自動模式拒絕了清理命令。 Claude 偵測到入侵，但自動模式阻止了其清理命令。安全機製本身也可能成為失效的原因之一。分類器允許建立惡意軟體進程，但隨後卻阻止了旨在停止該進程的命令！我同意 Johann 的結論：如果存在引起對抗性攻擊的風險，運行代理的唯一安全方法是使用沙箱：在容器、虛擬機器或作業系統沙箱中運行無人值守的編碼代理。限製網路出口。監控您的代理商。不要將主目錄、SSH 金鑰、雲端憑證等暴露給代理程式運行時。 [...] 標籤：沙箱、安全、人工智慧、提示注入、生成式人工智慧、LLMS、人本主義、Claude Claude Code Opus 5
